source_selection: One side-facing rhinoceros grazes with head lowered, head roots forward/down and tail swishes; later the body and camera shift left. All16 samples show one continuous enclosure shot, not locomotion away.

observation_time_note.method: Estimated local pixel appearance correspondence between frozen SAM JPEGs and retained raw frames; grayscale96x72RMSE<=2 andrunnerupgap>=.25. Ambiguous samples use clock interpolation between accepted anchors, or nominal12fps extrapolation at ends.

continuous_source.evidence: Sixteen raw-source samples visually inspected in preflight/source-design-sheet.jpg; final source-contact-sheet.jpg additionally spans refined clock interval. No cut/dissolve in selected event.

assembly_summary: The original seven-stroke rhinoceros grazes head-down, shifts within the frame and swishes a separately credited tail. Enclosure geometry follows a camera separate from the native cast.
bounded_repair_v2: V1 independent critic: native identity passes, grazing head/body allocation fails. Uniformly reduce each intact head+horn group to60%, place at five source-observed lower-right head anchors; extend/raise original torso vertices to back/shoulder and carry existing leg roots/tail. Late muzzle now crosses natural bottom crop. Original seven native strokes/pointcounts retained.
